This document lists the testing procedure P1, which must be 
performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block

The ICW51A relay is used to protect generator against 
motoring on loss at input energy to the gas turbine.

These relays are designed for operation at rated system 
voltage to detect an abnormal power flow in a given direction. for balanced load 
conditions only one relay is required per terminal .

The first draft initiated by Eng. Reda El Shenawey, tested 
by Eng. Khalied Diab & Eng. Ehab Abuo Elwafa , and accepted by 
general manager Eng. Saad Kheder and approved by Eng. Abd Elmoatey Elrakaiby 
Head Sector of Mahmoudia Power Station.

This 
 document is revised by eng. Adel El-Naggar: MDEPC quality control engineer, 
 accepted by eng. Samir Abdel-Gil;il: MDEPC quality control general director, and certified by eng. Mohamed Naguib: quality 
control head sector.

Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists the testing procedure P1, which must be 
performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the above title block
The ICW51A relay is used to protect generator against 
motoring on loss at input energy to the gas turbine.
These relays are designed for operation at rated system 
voltage to detect an abnormal power flow in a given direction. for balanced load 
conditions only one relay is required per terminal .
The first draft initiated by Eng. Reda El Shenawey, tested 
by Eng. Khalied Diab & Eng. Ehab Abuo Elwafa , and accepted by 
general manager Eng. Saad Kheder and approved by Eng. Abd Elmoatey Elrakaiby 
Head Sector of Mahmoudia Power Station.

 regist (REST) value.
Increase the current again to (2 P.U) value
Stop the test set
Restart the test set ( with voltage = 110 v & 
 current = 2 P.U value ).

Register the time value.
